name: PIMCO (Pacific Investment Management Company)
monetization: The world's largest active fixed-income manager (Allianz-owned); monetizes AI as the anchor buyer of the biggest investment-grade AI data-center bonds (Hyperion ~$18B; Saline Township ~$10B).
description_md: PIMCO is the Allianz-owned bond manager that has emerged as the single largest end-buyer of AI data-center debt. It anchored the two largest single-project financings of the cycle: Meta's Hyperion JV notes and the Related Digital/Oracle Saline Township, Michigan package.
ai_monetization_md: AI-exposure thesis: harvest long-duration, A-rated-ish spread on bonds whose credit is a hyperscaler lease rather than a corporate balance sheet. PIMCO-managed funds took ~$18B of the $27.3B Hyperion senior secured notes (6.581% coupon, final maturity 2049, S&P A+, backed by Meta's lease and a 16-year residual-value guarantee), and anchored roughly $10B of the ~$14B fixed-rate tranche in the $16.3B Saline Township financing for Oracle/Stargate after several US banks retreated — the largest single-facility technology debt package on record (closed April 2026).
risk_notes_md: Both anchor positions are single-tenant, single-campus exposures whose performance depends on Meta's and Oracle's willingness to renew leases on purpose-built AI assets with untested residual values. The ~$10B Saline anchor figure is single-sourced (flagged UNVERIFIED; the closing press release confirms PIMCO anchored the debt but not the amount). As a fund manager, losses would land on client accounts — including insurance mandates — rather than PIMCO's own balance sheet, which is precisely the transmission channel regulators (IMF GFSR, Fed FSR 2026) are watching.

events.title: Anchors Meta Hyperion JV bond with ~$18B take-down
events.why_it_matters: Establishes bond funds — not banks — as the marginal lender to the AI buildout, and concentrates a historic amount of single-project risk in one manager's client accounts.

events.title: Saline Township $16.3B financing closes with PIMCO as debt anchor
events.why_it_matters: The deal got done only after bank retrenchment (and Blue Owl's Dec 2025 exit) — evidence that AI project credit increasingly clears through a small set of bond managers.
